model.closed_collar_rule: compose a length-2 or length-3 word cyclically by identifying the final ordered output stubs with the first ordered input stubs
model.fixed_outer_fiber: one four-color key on the closing edges is fixed per run
model.radial_cut: the same closing edges, used as the fixed radial cut
model.tested_boundary_datum: the per-color-pair multiset of component winding classes, recorded as winding0 and winding1 component counts
model.winding_rule: for each two-color component, take the crossing count with the radial cut modulo 2
